mapper.select: SELECT u.*, r.role_name, r.role_code FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON u.role_id = r.role_id WHERE u.username = #{username} AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1
SELECT dept_code FROM sys_user_dept WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT hospital_id FROM sys_user_hospital WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE sys_user SET status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE sys_user SET is_deleted = 1, deleted_at = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
